relationships.subject: Trigeminal-mediated headshaking
relationships.evidence_quote: CSF CGRP levels were significantly increased in horses with TMHS and CVSM compared to those euthanised for other non‐neurologic painful, inflammatory or chronic conditions.

key_findings: CSF CGRP was higher in horses with TMHS and CVSM than in horses with other painful or inflammatory conditions, but serum and CSF CGRP did not correlate.
Serum CGRP in TMHS horses did not differ from controls before or after exercise-induced headshaking.
